title: fleet-job
description: Starts a fleet operation (docs/spec/13-roadmap.md modules 21 and 45): one fixed operation on up to 200 chosen cabinets, as a job with a fixed target list, run in batches, each cabinet's result and verification recorded. The parameters come from the server: each cabinet's site's zone for time.setZone, its client's policy for firewall.applyPolicy. Confirmed with the password: the token (action fleet.job, target jobId) is bound to {operation, cabinetIds, batchSize}.

jobId.description: Chosen by the console, so the confirmation is bound to this one job.

batchSize.description: How many cabinets are changed at a time; the next batch starts when this one has answered.
